title: In silico analysis of a MicroRNA regulatory network Influencing mitochondrial fission in hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Akki, Ali Jawad; Patil, Shankargouda V; Dongre, Nilima; Parvatikar, Prachi
one_liner_zh: 该文通过in silico分析构建miRNA调控网络，并对调控miRNA的转录因子WDR5和HNF4进行分子对接，虽涉及TF-DNA相关靶点与对接方法，但核心是miRNA与线粒体分裂，非TF-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: MicroRNAs (miRNAs), small non-coding RNA molecules known for their gene regulatory functions, are increasingly recognized to target genes critical for mitochondrial function in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). By employing in silico analysis this research investigates the underexplored involvement of a network of microRNAs in regulating mitochondrial fission within the context of HCC. We constructed a novel regulatory network, identifying hsa-miR-138-5p as a central regulator targeting key mitochondrial genes. Furthermore, we identified druggable binding pockets on the transcription factors WDR5 and HNF4, which regulate hsa-miR-138-5p. Molecular docking studies demonstrated favorable binding affinities of FDA-approved HCC drugs (sorafenib, lenvatinib, and regorafenib) to these binding pockets, suggesting an off-target mechanism by which these drugs might influence mitochondrial function through the hsa-miR-138-5p pathway. These findings contribute to the growing understanding of miRNA-mediated regulation in HCC and offer a foundation for developing novel microRNA-targeting drugs to modulate mitochondrial dynamics to manage HCC progression.
abstract_zh: 微小RNA（miRNAs）是一类已知具有基因调控功能的小型非编码RNA分子，日益被认识到其靶向肝细胞癌（HCC）中线粒体功能的关键基因。通过采用计算机模拟分析，本研究探讨了在HCC背景下，一组微小RNA在调控线粒体分裂中尚未充分研究的参与作用。我们构建了一个新型调控网络，识别出hsa-miR-138-5p作为靶向关键线粒体基因的核心调控因子。此外，我们确定了转录因子WDR5和HNF4上可药物结合的袋状结构，这些转录因子调控hsa-miR-138-5p。分子对接研究表明，FDA批准的HCC药物（索拉非尼、仑伐替尼和瑞戈非尼）对这些结合袋具有有利的结合亲和力，提示这些药物可能通过hsa-miR-138-5p通路影响线粒体功能的脱靶机制。这些发现增进了对HCC中miRNA介导调控的理解，并为开发新型靶向微小RNA药物以调节线粒体动态、管理HCC进展奠定了基础。
